minecraft:written_book_content.title: Burial Register
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Keeper
pages: {"text":"Three alcoves were prepared and left empty. The central tomb was sealed before the burial rites."}
{"text":"The stone above it is warm. The corridor is not."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The archive's oldest page lists these empty alcoves as 'occupied'. No names were ever added to the tombs."}
